nodes.label: fq-reader-spread-container flex:1 + space-between fill
nodes.rationale: On desktop the reader card was content-height, leaving unused vertical space (142px measured at 1440x900) above/below instead of feeding it into line gaps like mobile does; height must arrive via align-items:stretch at every level since height:100% resolves to auto inside a flex-grown box

nodes.label: min-height:800px gate for rhythm fill

nodes.label: ReaderPager.tsx (client persistent pager)
nodes.rationale: Swipes ended in router.push, a full route navigation remounting the whole reader and mounting ~1478 word components while deserializing a 2.27MB RSC payload — 183ms main-thread block. Solution: persistent client pager over slim static content, windowing render model

nodes.label: RecitationFollow leaf component (pager-owns-follow)
nodes.rationale: Because the pager navigates via history.replaceState, Next's usePathname() never updates, so RecitationContext.followPage silently stopped following; subscription must live in a null-rendering leaf (not ReaderPager itself) to avoid re-rendering the whole reader tree per recited word, and navigation must be deferred to a microtask since commitTo uses flushSync

nodes.label: app/utils/page-font-registry.ts (immutable FontFace registry + LRU)
nodes.rationale: Mutating a live <style> element's text makes the browser discard and re-parse its entire stylesheet, turning every @font-face into a new unloaded FontFace — including the currently-visible page's font. Fix: never mutate a live stylesheet; register each face once via the FontFace API and use per-face document.fonts.delete on LRU eviction

nodes.label: FontFaceInjector.tsx (base fonts via registry, tajweed keyed style)
nodes.norm_label: fontfaceinjector.tsx (base fonts via registry, tajweed keyed style)

nodes.label: baseFontIds scoping fix (isDouble vs isLgUp)
nodes.rationale: ensurePageFonts is eager (face.load() downloads regardless of render state) unlike lazy CSS @font-face, so unconditional rendering of FontFaceInjector started eagerly downloading the invisible spread-partner's font on every single-page session; isDouble (not isLgUp alone) is the correct scoping since it also covers desktop/tablet manually toggled to single

nodes.label: useLruIds() hook (render-phase state instead of ref mutation)
nodes.rationale: Mutating ref.current during render body violates React's pure-render contract — a discarded render pass (Suspense retry, interrupted transition) would leave the ref mutated; fixed with React's sanctioned 'adjust state during render' setState pattern to avoid an extra render pass / visible flash that a useEffect-based fix would introduce
nodes.norm_label: uselruids() hook (render-phase state instead of ref mutation)

nodes.label: RecitationPlayerBar.tsx (rail vs bar layout)
nodes.rationale: At >=1367px+800px the bar moves from a floating horizontal strip to a fixed vertical rail on the screen-right edge, reclaiming 104px bottom padding for the reader-rhythm ticket; rail overlays existing lateral whitespace with no asymmetric spread offset

nodes.label: StopPoint scopes (page/surah/rub/hizb/juz/none/custom)
nodes.rationale: A hizb/rub/juz boundary routinely falls in a later chapter than where playback started, requiring auto-continue into next chapter's audio — formally supersedes ADR 0021's original 'no auto-continue' consequence via an Addendum

nodes.label: Addendum 7 — whole-range repeat never looping (currentVerseKeyRef stale bug)
nodes.rationale: seekToRangeStart's same-chapter branch seeked audio back but never updated currentVerseKeyRef.current, so the stale ref made isStopVerse evaluate true again on the very next tick, burning through rangeRepeatsDone within a fraction of a second and stopping prematurely
nodes.norm_label: addendum 7 — whole-range repeat never looping (currentversekeyref stale bug)

nodes.label: Addendum 9 — Custom stop-at point (page or verse)
nodes.rationale: Existing stop points always derive end from a scope containing the start verse; custom adds an independent end point without a 'from' picker since start always stays whatever verse launched playback, avoiding a separate 'Play range' entry point
